meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 直接生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据书名和作者名自动生成专业小说封面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速为小说生成带标题和署名的封面图
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional novel covers from book title and author name
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate a cover image with title and author for your novel

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成小说封面设计师：根据书名、作者名和平台自动判断题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成带书名和署名的封面图，存为 PNG。有参考图时做图生图；可额外导出一版居中裁剪的上传尺寸图。
howto.when: 当用户说“帮我做个封面”等封面生成请求，或输入 /story-cover、/封面 时触发；缺少书名或作者名时会先询问补齐。

say.text: 帮我做个封面，书名《剑起苍澜》，作者青衫，发番茄
say.note: Claude 会开始生成并保存封面图

say.text: 生成封面图：书名《心动》，笔名小甜，走现言甜宠风
say.note: 按所选题材风格出图并保存

say.text: 用这张参考图做个悬疑封面，书名《雾中迷》，作者老猫
say.note: 参考图将作为底图进行图生图

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a cover designer: from title/author/platform, it picks a genre style and calls an image model to generate a cover PNG with title and author. With a reference image, it uses image-to-image; may export a cropped upload copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a cover (e.g. “make me a cover”) or enters /story-cover or /封面. If title or author name is missing, Claude asks first.

say_en.text: Make me a cover, title “Sword Rising”, author Qingshan, for Fanqie
say_en.note: Claude will generate and save the cover image.

say_en.text: Generate a cover: title “Heartbeat”, pen name Xiaotian, modern sweet-love style
say_en.note: Outputs a cover in the chosen genre style.

say_en.text: Make a suspense cover from this reference image: title “Fog Maze”, author Laomao
say_en.note: The reference image is used as base for image-to-image.
